name: 2D Gaussian Evaluation
definition: Computes the exponent term of the 2D Gaussian probability density function at given 2D points, used for rasterization or shading.
summary: 2D Gaussian Evaluation computes the exponent of the 2D Gaussian PDF by explicitly calculating the quadratic form from the covariance matrix, unlike the conic variant that uses pre-computed inverse covariance elements.
